task: T02 — market data foundation (FR1, FR7, FR8, FR52)

decision.why: FR1 names the EOD2 pipeline as the daily source and the code already pointed at this tree: seraph/ingestion/eod2_client.py DEFAULT_DATA_DIR and seraph/universe/instrument_type.py both resolve to vendor/eod2. No new dependency, no subscription, no architectural change — the pipeline existed and had simply never been run.
decision.destination: the project's own docker-compose research PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:5434 (FR8), brought up with the documented `docker compose up -d`. The 9.2 GB source volume on 5433 was NOT attached, migrated or modified.
rejected: A SQLite or file-based store: FR8 requires PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB.
Kite Connect for daily data: FR1 assigns Kite to INTRADAY only, and it needs a paid subscription plus a daily interactive token.

fr52.rule: filter to >=1000 listing days, THEN rank by 6-month median traded value, THEN take top 500 (the documented bug trap)
fr52.observed: Q_t = 2.00 exactly on every rebalance from 2010-07-01 onward
fr52.early_epochs: 2005-07 through 2010-01 are UNDERFILLED (299-474 names, Q_t 2.11-3.34). This independently reproduces AMENDMENT-02: N=500/Q=2 is not attainable for the 2008 epoch from this corpus. Reported, not worked around.

equity_filter.verified: NIFTYBEES and GOLDBEES correctly excluded as non-equity; RELIANCE, TCS, HDFCBANK admitted

idempotency.check: CT-1: re-running the same slice must insert 0

disclosed_approximation.note: EOD2 daily CSVs carry no traded-value column, so TOTTRDVAL is close x volume. eod2_client raises ESTIMATOR_FALLBACK saying so on every run. Exact values would need the bhavcopy path. FR52 ranks on this, so the ranking is on a proxy — disclosed, not silently substituted.

still_blocked.intraday_bars: EMPTY. FR1 sources 5-minute bars from Kite Connect for a ~100-symbol subset. scripts/backfill_intraday.py is implemented and checkpointed but requires a paid Kite subscription and a daily interactive login. This is the one genuine external blocker and it gates the Hawkes pillar's FRESH computation.
